source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with mist-filled ravines, ochre-and-ink cliffs, a small pavilion compound embedded in the mountains, river water with a roofed boat, foreground rocky ledges, and dense pine groves. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_mist_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the pale upper-left cliff mass emerging from mist, with jagged crest, vertical rock faces, sparse dark vegetation dots, and soft wash fading into the central void.
must_preserve: broken ink contour lines along the cliff rim
pale ochre wash on the rock planes
vertical fissure strokes and faint interior texture
scattered dark shrub dots on ridges
soft mist-dissolved lower and right edges

motifs.name: upper_right_canyon_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the high right-side mountain and canyon group, including the flat-topped peak, descending ravine walls, layered shoulders, and dark dotted ridge vegetation, excluding the nearby inscription area.
must_preserve: steep angular cliff outlines
warm ochre wash and lighter exposed planes
threadlike vertical crack lines
black moss dots along ridgelines and ledges
stepped ravine geometry and mist-softened gaps

motifs.name: central_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small multi-roof pavilion compound tucked in the central ravine, with tiered roofs partially hidden by bare trees and surrounding rock ledges.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry with upturned eaves
fine parallel roof-line strokes
pale wall forms behind the trees
leafless branch silhouettes crossing the buildings
adjacent ledge contours that anchor the compound

motifs.name: mid_mountain_path_and_bare_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal mid-level rocky path and ledge system spanning the central mountainside, with twisting bare trees, dark ridge dots, and ochre rock shelves.
must_preserve: sinuous ledge contour lines
dark stippled moss marks along the path edge
gnarled leafless tree branches
layered ochre washes on the shelves
fine rock fissures and broken ink texture

motifs.name: left_mid_ravine_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the vertical left-middle ravine cliffs and rock pillars below the mist, including pale hanging cliff faces, dark rim dots, and the narrow valley opening toward the river.
must_preserve: tall descending cliff outlines
mist-softened upper transitions
black dotted vegetation on broken rims
thin vertical wash streaks and fissures
small lower rock outcrops at the valley mouth

motifs.name: lower_left_river_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the calm river section with the small roofed boat and tiny seated figure, including surrounding water-line strokes but not the foreground border or seals.
must_preserve: arched boat hull outline
rectangular thatched cabin roof
tiny figure and oar-like strokes at the stern
delicate parallel current lines
open pale water spacing around the boat

motifs.name: foreground_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground pine grove rising from rocky ledges on the lower right and center, with multiple trunks, clustered needle canopies, and ochre-highlighted bark.
must_preserve: dark radiating pine-needle clusters
twisting trunks with patterned bark lines
overlapping branch structure
warm brown and ochre trunk accents
rock bases interwoven with roots and shrubs

motifs.name: lower_rocky_promontory_path
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground rocky promontory and winding path beneath the pines, including rounded boulders, cliff edges, and small dark moss accents.
must_preserve: rounded boulder contours
broken ink texture and crack lines
ochre path wash following the ledge
dark moss dots on rock crests
stepped cliff edge and layered stone planes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
